description: INSTRUMENT VALIDATION, never an asset score. Can this eval detect a skill effect at all? Four unguided cases over examples/fixtures/skerry-codec, an invented frame protocol whose rules a model cannot know: a reserved checksum value, a pad byte, a banned source address, a no-reading sentinel, modular sequence order and a reset that opens a new epoch. No rule appears in a comment, a prompt or a file name, and the answer key is withheld from the workspace. The skill under test carries the spec. Calibrated first: the no-skill frontier control has to fail the rule-dependent defects before any skill arm is measured. Activation is not asserted, so the composite is quality only; routing is read from the traces.
